records.deidentified_narrative: while on patrol police responded to the listed location for a major accident involving a pedestrian ped. upon arrival i contacted unit 1 driver (u1d), u1d advised me that he had a green light and proceeded to pass through the intersection. u1d advised me that he saw unit 3 and unit 4 [roadway] of travel. u1d [roadway] change to avoid hitting the two listed parked vehicles. at this point u1d advised he did not see ped walking across the crosswalk due to his dark clothing. u1d advised that is when he stuck ped. u1d advised that is when he stopped and called for police assistance. w1 advised me while waiting at the red light at the listed intersection, she observed ped having the right of way to [roadway] and proceeded to walk when instructed to by traffic control device. w1 observed unit 1 passing her on the left side at a high rate of speed. w1 advised me she observed unit 1 hit ped, causing ped to hit and go over the top of unit 3 and taking off unit 3's right side mirror. w1 stated that ped then collided into the tailgate of unit 4 causing the listed damages. w1 advised that is when u1d then stopped. both unit 3 and 4 were unoccupied at the time of the accident. ped stated that he felt pain in his lower back and lower extremities. ems made location and determined [medical facility] for further medical assistance. ped had non-life threating injuries. uedi and csi made location and processed the scene. the san antonio traffic investigations unit was then contacted and advised of the situation. i was informed by the traffic unit's detective that they were not going to make the listed location and advised to release the scene. central daylight sergeant was notified and advised of the updated situation. all parties involved were then given a case card and advised to call back if further police assistance was required. bwc/coban avail.

records.public_safe_text: while on patrol police responded to the listed location for a major accident involving a pedestrian ped. upon arrival i contacted unit 1 driver (u1d), u1d advised me that he had a green light and proceeded to pass through the intersection. u1d advised me that he saw unit 3 and unit 4 [roadway] of travel. u1d [roadway] change to avoid hitting the two listed parked vehicles. at this point u1d advised he did not see ped walking across the crosswalk due to his dark clothing. u1d advised that is when he stuck ped. u1d advised that is when he stopped and called for police assistance. w1 advised me while waiting at the red light at the listed intersection, she observed ped having the right of way to [roadway] and proceeded to walk when instructed to by traffic control device. w1 observed unit 1 passing her on the left side at a high rate of speed. w1 advised me she observed unit 1 hit ped, causing ped to hit and go over the top of unit 3 and taking off unit 3's right side mirror. w1 stated that ped then collided into the tailgate of unit 4 causing the listed damages. w1 advised that is when u1d then stopped. both unit 3 and 4 were unoccupied at the time of the accident. ped stated that he felt pain in his lower back and lower extremities. ems made location and determined [medical facility] for further medical assistance. ped had non-life threating injuries. uedi and csi made location and processed the scene. the san antonio traffic investigations unit was then contacted and advised of the situation. i was informed by the traffic unit's detective that they were not going to make the listed location and advised to release the scene. central daylight sergeant was notified and advised of the updated situation. all parties involved were then given a case card and advised to call back if further police assistance was required. bwc/coban avail.

records.public_safe_text: during my regular patrol routine, police responded to the above listed location for a major accident call for service. upon making the listed location, i observed unit 1 to be facing east bound on the [roadway]. i observed unit 1 passengers to be helping the listed pedestrian in front of his vehicle. as i approached the listed pedestrian and the passengers, i observed the listed damage to unit 1. i made contact with unit 1 driver and he stated he was traveling southeast bound on the [roadway], coming from a bar, and proceeded to turn on the [roadway] to travel eastbound. unit 1 driver stated as he was turning, he struck the listed pedestrian on the public roadway. unit 1 driver stated the listed pedestrian was walking in the middle of the roadway and not on the crosswalk. unit 1 driver stated as soon as he struck the listed pedestrian, he immediately stopped and called police. as i was talking to unit 1 driver, i could detect a faint odor of intoxicants emitting from unit 1 drivers breath. unit 1 driver appeared to be swaying from side to side as i was talking to him. i observed the listed pedestrian appear to have injuries to his head. i observed the listed pedestrians shoes to be on the opposite side of the roadway that the listed pedestrian was laying on. ems made the location and transported [medical facility] to treat his injuries he sustained from the crashduring police investigation, detectives from tid made the location to conduct their investigation. csi made the location to assist in the investigation. after tid concluded their investigation, a wrecker from richards towing made the location to tow unit 1 to growdon pound. ofc. j. delgado #0406 completed the dwi and intox assault report on the same [case id] as the crash. no further action taken.
